about: Control bar (object) scale of text frames (tfscale-c1): the frame's path, stroke, insets and column gutter, and the text the frame shows (character and paragraph attributes by sx, sy, sx/sy or sqrt(sx*sy); text overset or in another frame of the thread stays). Several objects are one selection: a plural specifier's transform(), as the other scaleByMany cases. Styled text: paragraph and character styles whose values come out as overrides.
